WITH target AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (SELECT id FROM pedidos WHERE $2 <> '' AND (msg_delivery_id = $2 OR msg_grupo_id = $2) AND estado IN ('confirmado','en_camino','llegue') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT id FROM pedidos WHERE $1 <> '' AND numero_diario = NULLIF($1, '')::int AND fecha_hora > now() - interval '18 hours' AND estado IN ('confirmado','en_camino','llegue') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT id FROM pedidos WHERE $1 <> '' AND id = NULLIF($1, '')::int AND estado IN ('confirmado','en_camino','llegue') LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT id FROM pedidos WHERE $3 <> '' AND (telefono = $3 OR telefono LIKE '%' || right($3, 8)) AND estado IN ('confirmado','en_camino','llegue') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT id FROM pedidos WHERE $4 <> '' AND $7 <> 'cita' AND (asignado_a = $4 OR asignado_a IN (SELECT nombre FROM deliveries WHERE numero = $4)) AND estado IN ('confirmado','en_camino','llegue') AND fecha_hora > now() - interval '18 hours'
       ORDER BY CASE WHEN $5 = 'llegue' THEN (estado <> 'confirmado')::int ELSE (estado = 'confirmado')::int END DESC, id ASC LIMIT 1)
  ) AS id
),
deliv AS (SELECT numero, nombre FROM deliveries WHERE numero = $4 LIMIT 1)
UPDATE pedidos SET
  estado = CASE WHEN $5 = 'en_camino' THEN 'en_camino' ELSE estado END,
  fecha_salida = CASE WHEN $5 = 'en_camino' AND fecha_salida IS NULL THEN now() ELSE fecha_salida END,
  asignado_a = COALESCE((SELECT numero FROM deliv), asignado_a)
WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM target)
RETURNING id, numero_diario, telefono, estado, fecha_salida, asignado_a, COALESCE((SELECT nombre FROM deliv), asignado_a) AS delivery_nombre;

UPDATE pedidos SET estado='entregado', fecha_entrega=now()
WHERE id = COALESCE(
  -- 1. Ticket citado o reaccionado (id del mensaje; viene vacío si escribió un número)
  (SELECT id FROM pedidos WHERE $2 <> '' AND (msg_delivery_id = $2 OR msg_grupo_id = $2) AND estado IN ('confirmado','en_camino','llegue') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1),
  -- 2. Número escrito o el del ticket citado: primero el número del día del ticket (#N), luego el ID interno
  (SELECT id FROM pedidos WHERE $1 <> '' AND numero_diario = NULLIF($1, '')::int AND fecha_hora > now() - interval '18 hours' AND estado IN ('confirmado','en_camino','llegue') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1),
  (SELECT id FROM pedidos WHERE $1 <> '' AND id = NULLIF($1, '')::int AND estado IN ('confirmado','en_camino','llegue') LIMIT 1),
  -- 3. Teléfono del cliente
  (SELECT id FROM pedidos WHERE $3 <> '' AND (telefono = $3 OR telefono LIKE '%' || right($3, 8)) AND estado IN ('confirmado','en_camino','llegue') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1),
  -- 4. Pedido en curso asignado a ESTE repartidor, SOLO si no citó ni reaccionó a un mensaje (se quitó el fallback "último pedido de cualquiera")
  (SELECT id FROM pedidos WHERE $4 <> '' AND $6 <> 'cita' AND (asignado_a = $4 OR asignado_a IN (SELECT nombre FROM deliveries WHERE numero = $4)) AND estado IN ('confirmado','en_camino','llegue') AND fecha_hora > now() - interval '18 hours' ORDER BY (estado <> 'confirmado') DESC, id ASC LIMIT 1)
)
RETURNING id, telefono, numero_diario;

WITH m AS (
  SELECT key->>'remoteJid' AS rj, coalesce(nullif(key->>'remoteJidAlt', ''), nullif(key->>'senderPn', '')) AS alt,
         (key->>'fromMe')::bool AS fm, "pushName" AS pn, "messageTimestamp" AS ts
  FROM "Message"
  WHERE "instanceId" = '3c8013fe-520d-41f9-82fc-64a517b98e25' AND key->>'remoteJid' NOT LIKE '%@g.us' AND key->>'remoteJid' NOT LIKE '%broadcast%'
), mapa AS (
  SELECT rj, max(alt) AS alt FROM m WHERE rj LIKE '%@lid' AND alt LIKE '%@s.whatsapp.net' GROUP BY rj
), t AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN m.rj LIKE '%@s.whatsapp.net' THEN m.rj ELSE mapa.alt END AS jid, m.rj, m.fm, m.pn, m.ts
  FROM m LEFT JOIN mapa USING (rj)
), n AS (
  SELECT split_part(jid, '@', 1) AS tel, max(ts) FILTER (WHERE NOT fm) AS ult, min(rj) FILTER (WHERE rj LIKE '%@lid') AS lid,
         (array_agg(pn ORDER BY ts DESC) FILTER (WHERE NOT fm AND coalesce(pn, '') <> ''))[1] AS pn
  FROM t WHERE jid LIKE '%@s.whatsapp.net' GROUP BY 1
  HAVING max(ts) FILTER (WHERE NOT fm) > extract(epoch FROM now() - interval '3 days')
)
SELECT n.tel,
       regexp_replace(coalesce(n.pn, (SELECT c."pushName" FROM "Contact" c WHERE c."instanceId" = '3c8013fe-520d-41f9-82fc-64a517b98e25'
                         AND c."remoteJid" IN (n.tel || '@s.whatsapp.net', n.lid) AND coalesce(c."pushName", '') <> ''
                       LIMIT 1), ''), '\s+', ' ', 'g') AS nombre,
       to_char(to_timestamp(n.ult), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SSOF') AS ultimo
FROM n ORDER BY n.ult DESC;

WITH excluir AS (
  SELECT unnest(ARRAY['595994103971', '595992641358', '595972867986', '595993279548', '595987257856', '595985735099', '595985614918']::text[]) AS tel
  UNION SELECT numero FROM deliveries
  UNION SELECT substr(clave, 8) FROM benjis_config WHERE clave LIKE 'prueba:%'
), base AS (
  SELECT coalesce(c.telefono, h.telefono) AS telefono, c.cliente_id, c.nombre, h.nombre_whatsapp
  FROM clientes c FULL JOIN contactos_chats h ON h.telefono = c.telefono
)
SELECT b.telefono, b.cliente_id, b.nombre, b.nombre_whatsapp, g.resource_name, g.nombre_sync, g.estado,
       (g.sync_en < now() - interval '1 hour') AS reintentar
FROM base b LEFT JOIN clientes_google g ON g.telefono = b.telefono
WHERE b.telefono ~ '^595[0-9]{8,10}$'
  AND b.telefono NOT IN (SELECT tel FROM excluir WHERE tel IS NOT NULL)
  AND (g.telefono IS NULL OR g.estado IN ('ok', 'error'))
ORDER BY b.cliente_id NULLS LAST, b.telefono;
